title: Aegisthus
summary: Aegisthus is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Mycenae, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2848. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2848 = 1185 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 786a
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2848. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2848 = 1185 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 786a
reign.note: Year cell "3530 2848 335". The third printed figure 335 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 6 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row.
